query:
UPDATE releases
           SET release_time = $2,
               dependencies = $3,
               target_name = $4,
               yanked = $5,
               rustdoc_status = $6,
               test_status = $7,
               license = $8,
               repository_url = $9,
               homepage_url = $10,
               description = $11,
               description_long = $12,
               have_examples = $13,
               doc_targets = $14,
               is_library = $15,
               documentation_url = $16,
               default_target = $17,
               features = $18,
               repository_id = $19,
               source_size = $20
           WHERE id = $1
